rationale: Use original-mix MMS for the short negation in Пощады не проси. Its onset/release remain stable with wider context, while isolated-stem alignment shifts the same token by over 0.5 s. The original stem token has confidence below 0.01; full Whisper gives this short token zero duration and is unsuitable. This removes the late highlight candidate without inventing a minimum duration. The word remains an explicit slow-listening target, not a certified boundary.
